codecExperiment.honestFinding: Integer fixed-point milli-units + .x8D v2 achieve 100.00% SHA-256 lossless roundtrip across 0..255, Tamil UTF-8, real PNG, real WAV, and 65,536 B streams, while honestly expanding incompressible 4,096 B random data (+64 B header -> 8.125 bpb) and confirming that 0.008 bpw belongs strictly to structured weight factorization/native STE training, not arbitrary lossless I/O compression.

xAtSequenceExperiment.clarificationNote: xAt = 65,536 is defined here strictly as maximum raw-byte sequence window capacity (64 KiB) per x8dContainerFormat.ts, separate from 65,536-weight Kronecker tiles in Section 03.

rows.label: Fixed 8×8 (64-Byte) Grid (Deprecated)

rows.label: Adaptive Entropy Spans + Dedup Cache

rows.label: Diamond-Chain Spine + Skip Edges (Hypothesis)
rows.verdict: Skips empty/redundant blocks via coarse markers; requires explicit index tags and gives smaller gains on unrepeated dense prose.

xAtSequenceExperiment.honestHypothesisAudit: Across the 65,536 B multimodal stream, Fixed 8x8 splits boundaries and drops needle recall when anchors cross 64 B walls (80.0%), whereas Adaptive Entropy Spans reduce active bytes to 82.0% (53,737 B). Note honestly: Diamond-Chain skip links only outperform flat adaptive spans when sparse/template repetition exists; on incompressible dense text, building coarse node indexes adds 6448 B of metadata overhead for negligible compute savings.

ncmUnifiedExperiment.honestEvaluationNote: Both models share the exact same 2,688–2,944 factor DOF Kronecker-STE backbone trained from random init over 4,744 multimodal bytes (Text, Math, GR00T, PNG, WAV) and evaluated strictly from reloaded .x8D v2 bytes (2682 B total incl. 128 B RVQ C1+C2 codebooks). Nested dropout + RVQ reduces average denoising steps (4 vs 4) via 0% System-1 exits, though small-DOF prototypes remain far short of fluent free-form generation.

upstreamRecommendations.recommendation: Adopt integer fixed-point milli-units for 0..255 <-> 0.000..0.255 I/O canonicalization, keep the magic-free 16B header + 48B/span CRC32 tail directory, and enforce per-payload Shannon fallback (verbatim span tag 0x01 when compressed >= raw).
upstreamRecommendations.evidenceGate: 100% SHA-256 parity across 0..255, Tamil UTF-8, real PNG, real WAV, high-entropy random, and 65,536 B xAt streams.

upstreamRecommendations.evidenceGate: Measured maxAbsDiff <= 1e-5 vs full FP32 dense matmul with 512x smaller peak RAM buffer.
